title: Four co-working sites in Lunavia, March
bodyMd: The table describes the four co-working sites run by one company in the city of Lunavia during March. "Desks" is the number of desks at the site. "Members" is the number of people holding a monthly membership there. "Desks occupied" is the number of desks in use on an average weekday. The monthly fee is the price of one membership.

columns.label: Desks occupied on an average weekday

data.caption: Lunavia co-working sites, March: desks, members, desks occupied on an average weekday, and monthly fee per member.

accessibilityText: A table with four rows, one per co-working site, and five columns. Arden: 120 desks, 210 members, 84 desks occupied on an average weekday, monthly fee 180 euros. Belmont: 80 desks, 150 members, 68 occupied, fee 220 euros. Corvo: 150 desks, 190 members, 72 occupied, fee 150 euros. Dunmere: 60 desks, 140 members, 48 occupied, fee 240 euros.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional company in a fictional city, written for this item set. Figures were chosen so that every rate a question asks for resolves by hand. Not derived from any real dataset or published test item.
